title: Challenging Assembly but worth the effort
text: Challenging Assembly but worth the effort. These look great and are sturdy....the only issue is that the holes didn't always line up with the screws and the screws were difficult to turn when screwing in but after putting in all the elbow grease, the tables look great

product_metadata.title: VASAGLE Nightstand, Set of 2 Side Tables with Adjustable Mesh Shelves, for Living Room, Bedroom, Industrial, Stable Steel Frame, 15.7”L x 15.7”W x 19.7”H (40 x 40 x 50 cm), Charcoal Gray + Black
features: An Industrial Touch: Practical, linear, and yet still chic. The industrial black steel frame and charcoal gray top of these side tables create an exciting mix of styles; this set fits perfectly next to your sofa or functions as a pair of nightstands

Flat or Slanted, You Choose: Each end table has two sturdy mesh shelves, both of which you can attach either flat or slightly slanted to properly position magazines, books, or a variety of other items on them

Competent Sidekick: Sturdy steel frame, durable particleboard panels—this unbeatable team works hand in hand and forms a strong foundation to support 44 lb on the table top and 11 lb on each mesh shelf

Swing the Allen Key: Thanks to the simple structure of the nightstands, our detailed instructions, and the included Allen key, you don’t need to have an engineering degree to assemble this set of 2 side tables
What You Get: A set of 2 industrial-style side tables from our INDESTIC Collection, adjustable feet, an easy assembly process with labeled parts and Allen key
